name: The Merit Register
visualPolicy: Established Merit Register ledger/editorial visual identity preserved. V9.3 changes search indexing only; no research, counselling or scoring logic is altered.
release_note: V9.3 adds shared acronym/short-form aliases for all 465 colleges and fixes global search availability on every page.
notes: canonical runtime datasets are shared across page bundles through js/shared-*-v8.js
Freshers Timeline phase timing remains blank when evidence is insufficient
Junior Culture evidence is source-labelled and is not a numerical ragging score
Choice Filling annotates reach but never reorders preferences by admission probability
Structured issue reports are stored locally in the browser and can be copied/exported; no report is transmitted automatically.
Every canonical college has generated acronym/location aliases; curated common aliases receive higher search priority.
All college-search surfaces use the shared alias-aware index.
